description: This file contains the implementation of the GatewayConnectionListener class, which manages and configures inbound gateway connections in the Orleans runtime. It sets up connection behaviors, participates in lifecycle events, and creates connection objects for incoming network traffic.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionListener
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for listening to incoming gateway connections and managing them within the Orleans runtime environment. Implements connection creation, lifecycle participation, and connection configuration.

methods.name: GatewayConnectionListener
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GatewayConnectionListener with necessary dependencies and configurations.

methods.name: Endpoint
methods.description: Property that returns the endpoint on which this listener is accepting connections.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GatewayInboundConnection instance for incoming connection contexts.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder with gateway-specific options.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Participates in the silo lifecycle, subscribing to runtime initialization and activation stages.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Handles the startup event for lifecycle participation, initiating binding procedures asynchronously.

methods.name: OnStop
methods.description: Handles the stopping event for lifecycle participation, performing cleanup asynchronously.
